notes: Issue #87 was a spike to check which files the CI reviewer reads on each PR, since it seemed to skip DEVELOPMENT.md and design/README.md. The body was written once, at 337 words, and never grew (2 versions on 2026-10-21). All the work went into 14 issue comments, about 2,600 words, as the Done when asked (I87-9): one comment per PR review run with what it read and what it found (IC87-0 to IC87-12). So results take most of the words, all in comments. There was no PR. The skill change was made in another issue's PR (#109, commit 92cbf09), which IC87-11 reports. Surprising: a hold decision (IC87-4) was reversed a day later in chat, and the only record of the reversal is one sentence inside a result comment (IC87-11). The closing comment gives the reason in two sentences (IC87-13). No struck-out questions, PR description, or decisions comment exist, so those questions don't apply.
